newsitem.title: USA: Industrial Services looks to increase value.
newsitem.headline: Industrial Services looks to increase value.

text.p: Industrial Services of America Inc said Friday it is exploring options to enhance the value of the company.
The company said that in recent weeks it has been involved in discussions with a number of investment banking firms and management experts, and hopes to form a relationship soon.
Industrial Services said the role of the investment banker will include the exploration of various alternatives for maximizing shareholder value in the future.
Industrial Services provides waste outsourcing and recycling services to corporate and municipal customers.
